name: Koukawa Oboro
source:
Faction: US Forces
Skill: Ninjutsu: Soul Transfer (Ninpou - Utsusemi no Jutsu "Shinteni"), Ninjutsu: "Temporal magic" and "Teletransportation", The Blushing Bride's Taima Arts (Hanayome no Taima Yahou), White Party (Howaito Paatii), The Masked Pervert (Kamen no Chijo), New Year Sexolution (Ichinen no Sei no wa Gantan ni Ari), Taima Dagger Arts: Double Destruction
Artist: [url=/s533]Kagami Hirotaka[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/58ed7ca76ec1417176e4689bf8f77d4c.png]US 4 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/dd2434f86c4230450e807daa3f7256d1.png]US 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/002796525f6085a0e6a456ffb4c68670.png]US 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/9aa49b0f374e046c1bda4c8286e610b8.png]US 5 Stars EX[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/1109d0f5967664941fcdefbcf74dbd04.png]US 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/b482ef096795895f7e1ae2a271768742.png]US 6 Stars[/url]
History:
[spoiler]She's the original Oboro that in a fight with Black in the Koukawa Massacre, almost lost her life, she transferred her soul into a different host body. Her corpse was seized and turned into Asagi's arch enemy, "[url=/c66527]Koukawa Oboro[/url]". She remained hidden afterward and joined the UFS, as a chief of the DSO Japanese branch. She has a strong, almost motherly bound to [url=/c66513]Koukawa Asuka[/url].[/spoiler]
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Koukawa_Oboro]breezewiki.com[/url]]
